sentences.en: The judge said that the case was outside of his jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 法官说这个案件超出了他的管辖范围。

sentences.en: Different jurisdictions often have distinct definitions of justifiable homicide.
sentences.zh: 不同的司法管辖区往往对正当防卫的定义不同。

sentences.en: This case is outside my jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 这个案子不在我的权限范围内。

senses.zh: 司法权; 裁判权 形容词: jurisdictional

mnemonic: juris（法律）+dict（说，命令）+ion→法律上命令→司法权
